seo.title: Corporate Benefits Management | Pension, Health & Wellbeing | Healio
seo.description: Healio combines corporate pension, health insurance, wellbeing coordination and employee communication into one managed benefits system.

hero.description: Individual benefits are easy to buy. Healio turns them into one managed system of pension, health insurance, wellbeing coordination and clear employee communication.

realityCheck.title: Can you answer these three questions with confidence today?
questions: What does your current provision cost — including product charges?
What share of your workforce understands and uses it?
Who reviews providers, contributions and communication regularly?
realityCheck.conclusion: If one answer is missing, action is needed — not necessarily a switch, but an honest review of the status quo.

calculator.title: One individual case becomes a responsibility.
calculator.description: First, the model shows the effect over {{years}} years for one employee. It then applies the same difference to every participating employee across the workforce.
calculator.controlsHint: Results update immediately when you change an input.
calculator.monthlyContribution: Modelled monthly savings contribution per participant
calculator.modelLine: One continuous model line: constant contributions, constant return assumptions and no interruptions over the selected period.
calculator.chartAria: Modelled provision line from {{startYear}} to {{endYear}} for two comparison scenarios and contributions
calculator.assumptions: {{employees}} employees × {{participation}}% participation = {{participants}} participants. {{contribution}} fully invested model contribution over {{months}} months. Assumed gross annual returns before costs are converted into equivalent monthly returns; each contribution is invested in arrears at month-end.
calculator.disclaimer: Simplified model calculation, not a forecast or guarantee. Product costs, tax and inflation are not included. The scenarios represent neither specific products nor comparable guarantee or risk profiles.
calculator.decisionPrompt: The question is not which scenario is right. The question is whether you know the costs, return assumptions and risks of your current solution.

responsibility.title: The decision does not end when the contract is signed.
responsibility.lead: The statutory pension provides a foundation. Additional security is built where provision starts early, remains understandable and is supported consistently over decades.
responsibility.description: For company leaders, corporate pension is therefore more than administration. Product costs, return assumptions, participation and communication all influence what ultimately reaches the workforce in 30 years.
responsibility.position: Healio makes this effect visible without promising returns. We compare assumptions, review existing solutions and translate long-term consequences into decisions that are robust today.

dai.title: Putting historical long-term returns into context
dai.description: For a 30-year monthly DAX savings plan ending in 2025, the Deutsches Aktieninstitut reports 7.8% a year. Costs and tax are excluded; a DAX savings plan is not a direct comparison with a corporate pension product.

destatis.title: Retirement security remains a real task
destatis.description: Final EU-SILC 2025 results show that 19.5% of people aged 65 and over were at risk of poverty; the income reference year is 2024.

bmas.title: A model calculation remains a model
bmas.description: Germany's Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs stresses that projections in the pension insurance report are model calculations, not forecasts.

solutions.title: Four building blocks. One benefits system.
solutions.description: A collection of policies is not yet a benefits strategy. Pension, health, prevention and ongoing management must work together so employees understand the value and companies stay in control.

items.title: A pension that does more than create administration.
items.description: We review existing plans and explain costs, return assumptions, guarantees, employer contributions and their effect on future provision.
points: Review existing plans and costs transparently
Explain provision clearly at employee level

items.title: Healthcare benefits employees understand immediately.
items.description: Corporate health insurance makes an employer benefit tangible now. We develop a level of cover that fits the workforce and the available budget.
points: Choose benefits suited to the workforce
items.note: Available benefits depend on the selected plan and its insurance terms.

items.title: One health day is not yet health management.
items.description: Healio supports the coordination of voluntary health-promotion and prevention services and involves the responsible internal and external parties.
items.note: Healio supports wellbeing coordination and voluntary health promotion. Statutory duties relating to occupational health and safety, return-to-work management or occupational medicine remain with the responsible parties.

items.title: A system needs someone to keep it running.
items.description: Benefits management does not end at signature. Healio connects plans, providers, processes and communication and remains the central point of contact.

economics.title: Looking only at the contribution leaves the calculation incomplete.
economics.description: Employer-funded pension and health benefits may — depending on the component and structure — qualify as business expenses. Additional statutory tax and contribution advantages may further change the company's effective cost.
economics.cta: Assess effective cost in a benefits review
economics.summaryText: A business-expense deduction is not a full reimbursement. Legal form, profit, tax rate, type of benefit and implementation all matter. Healio makes these factors transparent and, if requested, coordinates implementation with payroll and tax advisers.

facts.title: Understand business expenses correctly
facts.description: Business-related expenditure generally reduces taxable profit. It is not fully reimbursed as a result.

facts.title: Pension within statutory incentives
facts.description: Specific implementation routes are subject to statutory tax and contribution limits. The effect depends on the model selected.

facts.title: Structure health insurance correctly
facts.description: Employer-funded insurance cover can qualify as a benefit in kind under certain conditions. Cash subsidies are treated differently for tax purposes.

facts.title: Support qualified prevention
facts.description: Measures provided in addition to regular salary may remain tax-free up to EUR 600 per employee and year if statutory quality and purpose requirements are met.

economics.disclaimer: Tax and social-security treatment depends on the specific structure and applicable legal requirements. This is not tax advice.

process.title: Rollout is the beginning. Not the end.
process.description: Benefits create value only when employees understand them and HR can manage them reliably. Healio creates a robust process for both.

steps.title: Understand the status quo
steps.description: We review contracts, costs, subsidies, participation and existing communication.

steps.title: Build the business case
steps.description: You see which pension, health and wellbeing structure fits the company and its budget.

steps.title: Introduce it clearly
steps.description: We coordinate the decision, providers, employee communication and relevant internal interfaces.

steps.title: Manage it continuously

workforce.eyebrow: Alternative without a company benefit budget
workforce.title: If the employer budget is not ready yet, better health access does not have to wait.
workforce.description: The company enables access and internal communication. Employees decide voluntarily whether the Healio concept suits them. Health access can therefore start before an employer-funded budget is approved.
workforce.cardEyebrow: Entry route without a benefits budget
workforce.budgetSuffix: in potential insurance benefits over 2 years. A suitable statutory-insurance bonus may offset the employee contribution in whole or in part.
points: Information and personal support from Healio
workforce.note: Employees take out and fund the insurance themselves. A statutory-insurance bonus may offset contributions in whole or in part; full reimbursement is not guaranteed. Accessing a suitable bonus may require changing statutory health insurer. Benefits, contributions and bonuses depend on the plan, personal circumstances and actual bonus use.

faq.title: Four questions every company should answer.
faq.description: The greatest risk is not one imperfect decision. It is a system nobody challenges at all.

items.question: Do existing contracts have to be replaced?
items.answer: No. The benefits review starts with an open assessment. Sound solutions remain in place; changes are made only where costs, impact, processes or communication can be improved transparently.

items.question: How do we know whether our current solution is genuinely good?
items.answer: Not from the contribution alone. Costs, scope, return and guarantee assumptions, participation, employee understanding and ongoing administration all matter.

items.question: What does Healio handle after the rollout?
items.answer: Healio remains the central point of contact, coordinates providers and communication, supports employees with questions and reviews whether circumstances or action required have changed.

items.question: What if an employer-funded benefit budget is not available yet?
items.answer: The Healio employee concept can provide a voluntary entry route without an employer-funded benefit contribution. The company enables internal communication; employees make and fund their own decision.
